name: source_hitting
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd(); plan={'url':'https://arxiv.org/pdf/2109.09249','routes':['351988'],'destination':'sources/hitting.pdf','source_identity':'Average hitting time tree order original source 2109.09249','purpose':'Read exact average hitting time definition and Sidorenko comparison theorem proofs'}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'get-hitting.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'source_get_guard.py'),str(p/'get-hitting.json')],check=True)
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/pancake.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,check=True,text=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/pancake.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.stdout)
